newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber edges down on Palembang.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber edges down on Palembang.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged down in late trading on Wednesday after foreign buying in Palembang, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices edged down 0.25 cents/lb to 54.50-55.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.25-54.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and to 53.75-54.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.

"We sold March SIR20 at 53.75 fob Palembang this afternoon, down from 54.00 previously. I think prices could fall further down to 53.50 later today due to continued weak demand," one Jakarta dealer said.
